name: Polaris GOLDp
oneLiner: GOLDp (formerly pGOLD) is Polaris's pre-launch synthetic gold CDP token minted against pETH, tracking the gold price by oracle with no physical backing.
collateral: Synthetic gold exposure minted through Polaris CDP infrastructure using pETH / ETH-derived collateral, with no physical gold reserve or custodian
pegMechanism: Pre-launch CDP-style pAsset: users are expected to post pETH collateral, borrow GOLDp debt that tracks one troy ounce of gold, and redeem or liquidate through Polaris protocol mechanics rather than issuer-managed bullion redemption
launchPhaseDetail: Public testnet open on Sepolia at testnet.polaris.finance (shared infrastructure with USDp; the earlier app.testnet.polarisfinance.io host no longer resolves); official documentation is live at docs.polaris.finance. Polaris has moved from polarisfinance.io to polaris.finance (currently a coming-soon page linking the testnet, docs, and @polarisfnd), took its earlier blog offline, and now brands the asset GOLDp rather than pGOLD. Security review and audit-preparation phase underway with professional audits upcoming; mainnet date uncommitted (issuer prioritising security over speed). A $1M angel round with Ethereum Foundation, Liquity, LI.FI, Altitude, and Fusion participation was reported on September 4 2026, without a mainnet date.

featuredContent.description: TokenBrice traces Polaris's origins from Robert Lauko's bonding-curve research to today's three-pillar mission: counterparty-free yield, ETH-correlated alternatives, and restoring DeFi credibility against a backdrop where only $184.79M of the $338.9B stablecoin supply is non-freezable.

milestones.title: Polaris documentation renames pGOLD to GOLDp
milestones.description: The official docs at docs.polaris.finance describe GOLDp as a synthetic asset tracking the gold price by oracle against pETH collateral at a 115% minimum collateral ratio, with no physical gold; the Sepolia testnet app uses the GOLDp label throughout. The earlier Polaris blog posts used pGOLD.

milestones.title: Polaris closes $1M angel round with Ethereum Foundation, Liquity, and LI.FI participation
milestones.description: Polaris reported a $1 million angel round joined by the Ethereum Foundation, Fusion (IPOR), Altitude, Liquity, LI.FI, and more than 30 founders and contributors including Anthony Sassano, to build pETH as yield-bearing collateral for USDp and GOLDp. No mainnet date accompanied the round, and the Polaris blog carried no post about it.
